relationships.summary: Early/rare Tang cobalt decoration and later mature Yuan/Jingdezhen blue-and-white are distinct chronological claims and must not be collapsed into one tradition.
relationships.resolution_policy: Keep both claims; use the requested historical strictness to adapt, qualify, or hybridize the later visual convention rather than treating the claims as contradictory facts.
relationships.user_facing_note: Tang cobalt evidence does not make mature later blue-and-white porcelain a standard Tang object.

relationships.summary: The surviving corpus and current museum surface are selective evidence for original ancient visual experience.
relationships.resolution_policy: Separate original/in-period reconstruction from excavated/conserved appearance and preserve survival bias in the prompt/audit.
relationships.user_facing_note: Present-day white marble and the surviving material mix are not neutral proxies for original appearance/prevalence.

note: No direct scholarly source disagreement is asserted in the current narrow V3.1 evidence set. These records model chronological variation and interpretive tension. Future genuine disagreements should use type=disagreement and preserve competing claims rather than selecting a winner silently.
